props.statement: In a conversion operation with internal heat exchange from the catalyst bed to the incoming feed, conversions of about 10 to 15 percent are obtained with total feed to fresh feed ratios as high as 9:1; in the present invention a total conversion per pass of about 25 to 30 percent is obtained with about 5 to 6 percent per stage, and a total feed to fresh feed ratio of 3-4:1 is employed.

props.statement: While methane is a preferred feed, other gases such as ethane and propane may be used; natural gas (mostly methane with minor ethane, propane and butane) is preferred in practice, and mixtures of hydrocarbons with 1 to 4 carbon atoms or the substantially purified hydrocarbons may be the feed stock.

props.name: methanol from methane: reforming heated by burning part of the feed; methanol synthesis in several zones fed in parallel with serial product flow and external heat removal

evidence.quote: method for producing methanol from methane in which
plurality of reaction zones, each containing a conversion 40
nol and to provide from about 5 to about 6 percent con-
removing heat externally and providing the specific de-

props.statement: Methanol is produced from methane by dividing the feed: one portion is contacted with steam and carbon dioxide (from a later step) over a catalyst at elevated temperature to give synthesis gas, the other is burned to provide the heat; CO2 recovered from the cooled combustion gas and the steam generated are returned to the feed; the synthesis gas with recycle gas is passed in parallel, while recycle gas and product flow serially, through several reaction zones each containing a conversion catalyst, giving about 5 to 6 percent conversion per zone, with heat removed externally between zones, which substantially diminishes the recycle gas.

props.name: Claim 1: synthesis gas with recycle passed in parallel through serially interconnected zones, 5-6% conversion per zone, external interzone heat removal, second portion to the last zone

evidence.quote: prises passing a first portion of an admixture of synthesis
a conversion from about 5 to about 6 percent in each

props.statement: A method of producing methanol by passing a first portion of an admixture of synthesis gas (CO and H2) with recycle gas in parallel through serially interconnected reaction zones each containing a bed of conversion catalyst, giving about 5 to 6 percent conversion in each zone, the total product of each zone passing in series to the next preceding zone, removing heat of reaction externally between zones, introducing a second portion of the admixture into the last zone and recovering the total products from the first zone, whereby recycle gas is substantially diminished and conversions increased.
